2608.04714.title: What We Observe as LLM Behavior Can Be a Side-effect of Inference Backend
2608.04714.paper_summary: Benchmark scores are reported as properties of a model, yet the inference framework used to produce them, such as HuggingFace, vLLM, or Ollama, are considered non-influential and their names and versions are almost never disclosed. In this work we investigate how much this choice can influence the model output. In a fully-crossed study (three instruction-tuned models x five inference frameworks x six benchmarks x four generation modes) we investigate how different tools (wrappers/backend) influence benchmark scores and how their score changes is influenced by generation hyper-parameters. We find backend to be a non-negligible factor where even under greedy, sampling-noise-free decoding, changing the backend can significantly alter models performance and this effect is structural and strongly model-dependent. Decomposing the variance according to generation mode reveal that considerable portion of the variability (roughly 39\%) a practitioner sees out-of-the-box can stem from the backend, while the remaining stems from sampling noise and each framework's default generation parameters, both of which are avoidable by disclosing and matching the generation configuration. These divergences are more pronounced on factual than on social-bias benchmarks. Overall, benchmark numbers are not backend-agnostic therefore, we recommend disclosing the backend, its version, and the full generation configuration, also using deterministic decoding for cross-backend comparison.
2608.04714.paper_summary_zh: 基準分數被報告為模型的屬性，但用於產生這些分數的推理框架，如 HuggingFace、vLLM 或 Ollama，則被視為不具影響力，其名稱和版本幾乎從未披露。在這項工作中，我們調查了這一選擇對模型輸出影響的程度。在一項完全交叉的研究中（三個指令調整模型 x 五個推理框架 x 六個基準 x 四種生成模式），我們調查了不同工具（包裝器/後端）如何影響基準分數，以及它們的分數變化如何受到生成超參數的影響。我們發現後端是一個不可忽視的因素，即使在貪婪的、無採樣噪聲的解碼下，改變後端也能顯著改變模型的性能，這種效果是結構性的，並且強烈依賴於模型。根據生成模式分解方差顯示，實踐者在開箱即用的情況下所看到的變異性中，有相當一部分（大約 39\%）可能源自後端，而其餘部分則來自採樣噪聲和每個框架的默認生成參數，這兩者都可以通過披露和匹配生成配置來避免。這些差異在事實性基準上比在社會偏見基準上更為明顯。總體而言，基準數字並不是後端無關的，因此我們建議披露後端、其版本以及完整的生成配置，同時在跨後端比較中使用確定性解碼。
